text: Learning a new skill takes time and effort. First, you need to practise regularly, even if it is only for a short time each day. Patience is just as important, because progress rarely happens quickly. There are many resources you can use, such as online videos, books or apps, and they can make learning easier. It also helps to track your progress so you can see how much you have improved. Finally, motivation is the key to success. When you remember why you started, it is easier to keep going and reach your goal.
